pages.title: Overview

pages.summary: Details the two CI/CD layers of CapsuleBay: GitHub Actions for cloud validation and Jenkins for self-hosted deployments.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.summary: Instructions for deploying the core infrastructure required for CapsuleBay, including Vault and local registry setup.

pages.title: Managing Capsules
pages.summary: Guidelines for adding new capsules, including folder structure and necessary files.

pages.title: Pipeline Parameters
pages.summary: Overview of the parameters used in the CapsuleBay pipeline, including options and descriptions.

pages.title: Vault Integration
pages.summary: Explains how CapsuleBay integrates with HashiCorp Vault for secret management during deployments.

pages.title: Security Stack
pages.summary: Describes the layered security checks implemented in CapsuleBay, including tools and their purposes.

pages.title: Discord Notifications
pages.summary: Details the Discord notifications sent at the end of each pipeline run, including the information provided.
